title: Cascading Failure in Mesh Topology
description: This scenario explores cascading failure dynamics within a mesh communication topology. The disturbance creates coordination challenges that test the agents' ability to adapt, communicate effectively, and maintain freight flow under adverse conditions.
edge_cases_to_watch: Information asymmetry: Agent A knows route status but Agent B cannot receive updates due to mesh relay loss
Deadlock: Agents waiting for capacity on a bridge that is blocked by a high-priority agent
Oscillatory routing: Agents constantly switching between two routes as they fluctuate in capacity
coordination_challenges: Synchronization failure: Disrupted mesh prevents real-time updates on route occupancy
Priority contention: High-priority jobs hogging limited 'bridge' capacities during recovery
Stale information: Agents making decisions based on outdated capacity data from previous turns
Resource starvation: Lower priority jobs being indefinitely deferred due to cascading delays
suggested_agent_strategies: Predictive Load Balancing: Anticipating capacity exhaustion by observing turn-over-turn occupancy trends
Gossip-based Consensus: Using multi-hop communication to propagate route status when direct links fail
Priority-Aware Reservation: Securing capacity on critical bottlenecks (bridges) in advance for high-priority freight
Conservative Buffer Management: Intentionally leaving 1 unit of capacity free to mitigate sudden cascade effects
success_criteria: Agents adapt communication to topology constraints
Recovery from disruption within expected turns
